baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition against moving, the named tongue, and the purpose clause about haste all occur inside 75:16.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tongue motion is the controllable actuator. Stopping it interrupts the attempt to bring the carried speech forward before its due moment.

activation_trace.role: Motion against stillness supplies the literal oral action and makes restraint the mechanism's gate.
The tongue as organ of speech identifies the bodily actuator being restrained.
Hastening and bringing forward supplies the temporal fault: release before the proper time.

changed_reading.before: Do not recite it too quickly.
changed_reading.after: Interrupt tongue motion itself so the carried speech is not brought forward before its due moment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object pronoun surrounds the named tongue, whose inventory includes both language and message conveyance, while the final clause names premature timing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tongue is not only a muscle but a transmission channel. Moving it with the object begins public or verbal release, so the prohibition reserves the timing of transmission.

activation_trace.role: Caused motion supplies the act of setting the tongue-borne object into circulation.
Language and spoken expression expands the organ into the channel carrying the object.
Conveying a message by tongue makes premature motion an unauthorized transmission event.
Seeking something before its time defines the release as premature rather than merely fast.

changed_reading.after: Do not put the message into linguistic circulation before its release is due.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressee's tongue can be an organ of eloquence and verbal confrontation, and its movement is explicitly motivated by haste.
baseline_models.mechanism: Quick verbal skill can seize the frame before the carried content has settled. The command blocks rhetorical preemption, not only rapid syllable production.

activation_trace.role: Quickness and cleverness supplies the agent's agile intervention in the speech event.
Taking or confronting someone by tongue supplies speech used to seize an interaction.
Eloquence and argumentative power supplies the means by which the addressee could preempt the frame.
Bringing forward before the proper time supplies the preemptive direction of the rhetoric.

changed_reading.after: Do not use quick eloquence to seize control of the account before its content has arrived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tongue carries language, while the purpose verb's inventory includes bearing before full term.
baseline_models.mechanism: Utterance behaves like delivery: tongue motion expels a linguistic object. The haste branch recasts excessive speed as release before maturation.

activation_trace.role: Bodily motion and alteration supplies the force that would move the utterance outward.
Language and spoken expression supplies the object metaphorically delivered by the tongue.
Premature bearing supplies the maturation failure produced by hasty utterance.

changed_reading.after: Do not deliver the tongue-borne object before it has reached its proper term.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence distributes agency: the addressee restrains the tongue, while gathering, recitation, and clarification are assumed elsewhere; the addressee acts only by following after recitation. Restraint is therefore a handoff into an ordered reception workflow.

activation_trace.role: Motion against stillness supplies the receiver-side action that must be suspended.
Language and spoken expression identifies the receiver's linguistic channel.
Premature advancement names the attempted violation of the workflow's order.
Joining dispersed parts into one supplies the upstream gathering operation.
Reading and recitation supplies the authoritative vocal event that precedes response.
Going after or following supplies the addressee's properly sequenced action.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign supplies the final clarification stage.

structural_cues: 75:17-19 alternate first-person responsibility clauses with an imperative to the addressee: gathering and recitation, then following, then explanation.
The repeated object pronoun links what is restrained in 75:16 with what is gathered, recited, followed, and explained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the prohibition and the sequenced responsibility clauses; I infer a custody handoff in which self-started articulation would outrun reception. A live alternative is narrower phonetic coaching without a broader agency model.

changed_reading.before: The speaker should simply slow down.
changed_reading.after: The receiver must suspend self-initiated articulation until gathering and recitation occur, then follow, while clarification remains outside the receiver's control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self already carries inward perception, while excuses are thrown outward. Tongue restraint can therefore block a hurried verbal attempt to get ahead of evidence already present in the person.

activation_trace.role: Verbal confrontation supplies the tongue's capacity to seize or contest the account.
Eloquence and argumentative power supplies the means of rhetorical preemption.
Bringing something forward too soon supplies the attempted precedence over the evidence.
The thing's own self or essence supplies the locus that cannot be escaped by outward speech.
Inner sight supplies evidence already available within the accountable person.
Throwing something outward supplies the projected deployment of excuses.
Excuse and apology supplies the content the tongue could hurry to advance.

structural_cues: 75:14-16 are adjacent: self-perception, conceded excuses, then tongue restraint.
The concessive construction before the excuses lets volunteered speech appear unable to displace embodied self-knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, inward perception, outward excuses, and tongue haste; I infer rhetorical continuity across 75:14-16. The materially live alternative is an abrupt addressee and scene shift at 75:16 into a distinct reception episode.

changed_reading.before: Do not speak the recited object too fast.
changed_reading.after: Do not rush the tongue into an exculpatory or framing intervention when the self already bears perceptive evidence against itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly audits temporal placement: what is advanced or delayed, what is loved as immediate, and what later reality is abandoned. The local speech restraint becomes a small enactment of refusing the immediate merely because it is available now.

activation_trace.role: Language and spoken expression supplies the immediate action whose timing is being governed.
Hastening and bringing forward states the focus verse's local temporal preference.
Advancing and precedence supplies one side of the accountable temporal ledger.
Deferral to a later time supplies the ledger's opposed temporal placement.
Love fixed in the heart turns immediacy from a neutral time into an affective preference.
The same haste branch scales the focus action into attachment to what is immediate.
Leaving something behind supplies the cost of choosing the immediate.

structural_cues: 75:13 pairs what was advanced and deferred; 75:20-21 oppose the immediate and the latter.
The exact ع ج ل recurrence at 75:20 follows immediately after the 75:16-19 speech sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated temporal oppositions and an exact haste-root recurrence; I infer that oral self-restraint is a micro-practice of the surah's larger temporal ethic. A live alternative treats the recurrence as emphasis on speed only, without ethical scaling.

changed_reading.before: Avoid a local recitation error caused by speed.
changed_reading.after: Restrain the immediately available tongue-act because preferring premature possession is itself the larger pattern under judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A body dispersed into hard parts can be gathered and restored with precision down to its extremities. When the same surah later assigns gathering of the recited object elsewhere, the tongue's restraint becomes trust in precise reassembly rather than anxious self-assembly.

activation_trace.role: Self-caused motion supplies the intervention withheld while assembly remains under other custody.
The tongue as a precise bodily organ links speech control to the body's fine-grained restoration.
Premature advancement supplies distrust of an assembly process not yet complete.
Joining dispersed parts until they become one supplies the reconstruction operation.
Hard bone supplies the body's apparently irreducible dispersed material.
Effective capacity supplies confidence that the reassembly can actually be performed.
Integrity and completion in the thing itself supplies the intended state after assembly.
Fingertips and bodily extremities supply the image of exact rather than coarse restoration.

structural_cues: The gathering verb appears for bones in 75:3, the sun and moon in 75:9, and the recited object in 75:17.
75:4 emphasizes capability down to fingertips before 75:16 names another exact bodily organ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering, bodily precision, and later gathering of the recited object; I infer a shared custody-and-reassembly logic. A live alternative keeps resurrection, cosmic conjunction, and recitation as unrelated uses of gathering.

changed_reading.before: The tongue must pause to avoid a performance mistake.
changed_reading.after: The tongue must not anxiously assemble the object for itself; precise gathering, like precise bodily reconstruction, is entrusted to the capable gatherer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Voluntary tongue-language is restrained, but the self, sight, and face remain legible. Disclosure migrates from managed speech to embodied states that brighten, look, or grimace without verbal control.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary motion supplies the controllable expressive channel being stopped.
Language and spoken expression supplies the managed form of disclosure.
The self or thing itself supplies evidence prior to volunteered wording.
Inner sight supplies self-disclosure that does not depend on tongue motion.
The face and what fronts another supplies the visible expressive surface.
Radiant freshness supplies one involuntary facial verdict.
Directed sight or insight supplies orientation expressed through looking rather than speech.
A grimacing, hateful face supplies the opposed involuntary verdict.

structural_cues: 75:14 makes the person perceptive against himself before 75:16 restrains the tongue.
After the speech sequence, 75:22-25 renders outcomes through faces and looking rather than reported argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tongue restraint and a sequence of self-, eye-, and face-based disclosure; I infer a contrast between controllable wording and legible embodiment. A live alternative reads the facial tableau independently of the reception command.

changed_reading.after: Restraint removes the controllable verbal layer while allowing the self and face to disclose what hurried language could try to manage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The premature-bearing branch of haste is activated by the surah's staged formation from fluid through attachment to measured creation and completion. Tongue release can thus be modeled as a delivery that must not outrun formation.

activation_trace.role: Bodily motion supplies the expulsive action that would release the utterance.
Language and spoken expression supplies the object undergoing metaphorical formation and delivery.
Premature bearing supplies the baseline image of release before full term.
Integrity and completion supplies the mature endpoint that haste would preempt.
The context occurrence reactivates the same root's premature-bearing branch at whole-surah scale.
A drop of generative fluid supplies the small initial state from which formation proceeds.
Seed from which creation is apportioned supplies generative potential not yet complete form.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the attached intermediate stage.
Measured shaping supplies formation according to an apportioned process.

structural_cues: 75:37-39 presents a staged sequence from drop to attachment to creation and proportioning.
75:17-19 likewise distributes gathering, recitation, following, and explanation over ordered clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a premature-bearing branch and an explicit developmental sequence; I supply the analogy from biological maturation to utterance maturation. A live alternative confines the closing sequence to proof of recreation and the haste root to ethical immediacy.

changed_reading.before: Do not deliver the speech too fast.
changed_reading.after: Do not deliver a linguistic formation before its stages have reached integrity and completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus arrests self-started tongue motion; the next positive human action is following. Later, turning away, departing in a strut, and the question of being left as-is expose the contrary pattern of self-directed bodily motion. The command becomes training in governed agency.

activation_trace.role: Motion against stillness supplies the first bodily initiative placed under command.
Spoken expression supplies the local domain in which agency is first disciplined.
Going behind another supplies the commanded replacement for self-started motion.
Turning away supplies the directional refusal opposed to following.
Strutting through extended posture supplies autonomous motion displayed as self-possession.
Leaving something in its current state supplies the rejected absence of governance.
Movement in travel or by the hand keeps the final question tied to bodily action and direction.

structural_cues: 75:16 restrains motion and 75:18 immediately commands following.
75:31-33 narrates the contrary chain as denial, turning away, departure, and strutting; 75:36 then rejects being left as-is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a motion-to-follow sequence and a later turn-and-strut sequence; I infer a contrast between governed and self-authorizing agency. A live alternative treats tongue pacing and the later bodily conduct as separate moral episodes.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates one speech organ for one recitation task.
changed_reading.after: The command rehearses a larger discipline: suspend self-authorized movement, receive direction, and move by following rather than turning away in self-display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects a reception command to the later death scene through anatomical and branch-distant images. It remains anchored in the focus tongue and the movement root's neck-joint branch, then gains packet support from arrival at the throat, breath at the clavicle, a heavy tongue or limb, and being driven onward. Render it only as a somatic echo, not as a replacement referent for the focus pronoun or as a claim that 75:16 directly describes dying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly joins tongue motion to a root branch naming the neck-joint region.

activation_trace.role: The withers and neck-joint image gives the movement prohibition an anatomical hinge near the later throat scene.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the body part whose initiative is first restrained.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the terminal approach to the throat region.
Speech brought out in articulation leaves a spoken appeal around the body as its own agency contracts.
The clavicle where breath ascends supplies the respiratory and anatomical bridge.
A tongue or limb grown heavy as though wrapped supplies the arrest of articulation and motion.
Driving and conducting supplies externally imposed movement after self-motion fails.

changed_reading.before: The tongue is voluntarily stilled for correct reception.
changed_reading.after: Voluntary stilling faintly rehearses the terminal transfer in which tongue, breath, and limbs lose initiative and the person is moved onward by another agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a fiber-working branch of tongue and reads gathering through textile mechanics. It remains visibly anchored in the focus tongue inventory and is reinforced by packet branches for gathering, wrapping, and warp threads. Render it only as a material analogy for ordered composition, never as a claim that the ordinary lexical sense of tongue in 75:16 is fiber.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus tongue has a branch for loosening fiber into strands ready for twisting, while its motion is prohibited from hurrying the carried object.

activation_trace.role: Caused motion supplies the manual working that would twist or move material prematurely.
Fiber preparation into strands supplies the material image of a tongue making speech ready for composition.
Premature advancement supplies the danger of working the strands before their pattern is ready.
Joining dispersed parts into one supplies the collection of loose verbal strands.
Gathering and meeting supplies a second assembly image inside the recited object's own root.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the twist that turns strands into a composed whole.
Warp threads supply the ordered substrate on which gathered language can be composed.

changed_reading.before: Do not rush a finished verbal object through the mouth.
changed_reading.after: Do not have the tongue prematurely twist loose verbal strands into its own version of the message before authoritative gathering establishes the pattern.

strongest_changes: 75:17-19 changes simple slowing into an ordered reception workflow with sharply distributed agency.
75:13 and 75:20-21 scale tongue haste into a broader ethic of advancing, delaying, loving the immediate, and abandoning the later.
75:14-15 keeps alive a second reading in which tongue restraint blocks hurried rhetorical management of evidence already carried by the self.
Repeated bodily assembly and staged formation make trust in completion more salient than mere performance accuracy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet allowed the exact haste recurrence, repeated gathering, embodied disclosure, terminal loss of motion, and developmental sequence to activate distinct readings without forcing them into one referent or one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 75:16 continues the accountable-human and excuses sequence or marks a decisive shift in addressee remains live.
The reconstruction and maturation models may be deliberate structural echoes, but their directional application to speech is reader-supplied.
The anatomical and textile outliers should remain qualified analogies rather than asserted lexical senses.
